summary: MarketWise, Inc. filed an 8-K (Items 1.01, 9.01) reporting a Settlement Agreement with former CEO Mark P. Arnold and JAMA 2021, LLC. Terms include a $12.16M cash payment, redemption of 520,867 common units and corresponding Class B shares, mutual releases, waiver of Tax Receivables Agreement rights, and indemnification for certain tax implications. The settlement resolves a previously disclosed arbitration without admission of liability. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or capital event is present; it is a routine dispute resolution. Management remains focused on strategic priorities.
